subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ and column ‘B’ to write five complete
stimulus: sentence. There are more parts of sentences in column ‘B’ than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B a. Language is a i. meant for human feelings b. We communicate with others ii. do not mean language c. Language is made of iii. meant for all types of creatures d. All the sounds iv. all kinds of sounds. e. Language is v. media of expressing our feelings vi. through language. vii. particular kinds of sounds.
guide_solution: (a) + v) : Language is a media of expressing our feelings (b + vi) : We communicate with others through language. (c + vii) : Language is made of particular kinds of sounds. 42 (d + ii) : All the sounds do not mean language (e + i) : Language is meant for human feelings
